_provenance: Hand-labelled from the source PDF. Howey-in-the-Hills FL, Water Treatment Plant No. 3, 90% submittal (Halff). Section 16370 Variable Frequency Drives, pp1-7, plus two elementary-diagram sheets E-08 and E-07.
_section_index_notes: 18 headings, all on pp1-7. Nothing on pp8-9 is a heading: the drawing sheets contain no document structure. Any node emitted from p8 or p9 is a false positive.
_pairing_note: This file asserts NO VFD-motor pairs. Section 16370 is a generic requirement clause covering every drive on the project; 1.03.A explicitly defers ampacity to the single-line diagram on the electrical sheets. Equipment tags live in 98878_2_HoweyOneline.pdf. A run over this file alone that returns a non-empty vfd_motor_pairs[] has hallucinated it.

value_grounding._note: AMBIGUOUS IN THE SOURCE - needs ABB adjudication, not a better model. Clause 2.02.H.1 'Minimum speed (1 to 60 HZ)' gives 1 Hz; clause 2.02.F.4 'Variable torque performance from 4 to 60 Hertz' gives 4 Hz. In a bake-off gpt-5.4-mini returned 4 citing F.4 and gpt-5.6-sol returned 1 citing H.1; both citations are real and verifiable. Until ABB rules, this is a Conflict to surface, not an extraction error to score.

_traps: pp8-9 are landscape scanned drawing sheets. Their title blocks are tables inside a figure and must be claimed by the DRAWING region, not emitted as a schedule.
The handwritten ampacities are the only source for drive sizing and appear on no printed line.
Sheet E-08 covers WELL PUMP SOLID STATE STARTERS, which are not VFDs. Section 16370 does not apply to them.
